passage:
A group of students wanted safer sidewalks near their school. Instead of shouting, they placed empty shoes along the road where students often had to walk beside traffic.
Each pair of shoes had a note: "A student should be able to walk here safely."
The display surprised drivers and city workers. Photos spread online, and the city agreed to review the road.
Some people said the protest was too quiet. Others said that was why it worked. It made people stop and think without blocking the street.
The students learned that a strong message does not always need loud voices. Sometimes silence, arranged carefully, can speak clearly.
